title: The possible $K^{*}Σ^{*}$ molecular state
summary: Within the framework of the one-boson-exchange model, we systematically investigate the interaction between the vector meson $K^{*}$ and the baryon $Σ^{*}$ with the aim of exploring the possibility of forming hadronic molecular states. The $K^{*}Σ^{*}$ interaction potential is constructed from $ρ$, $ω$, and $π$ meson exchanges, and the nonrelativistic Schrödinger equation is solved using the Gaussian expansion method.
